book.energizedpower.page.item_conveyor_b: The Item Conveyor Belt Loader can extract items from any storage blocks (even other conveyor belts) and load them onto a conveyor belt.
The larger square must face the block where items are extracted from and the smaller square must face a conveyor belt.
Alternatively items can be extracted from the loader with hoppers and other blocks which can extract items from blocks.
It can be stacked vertically and horizontally.
It can be disabled with a redstone signal.

book.energizedpower.page.item_conveyor_b: The Item Conveyor Belt Sorter takes items from an input conveyor belt and routes them to certain output conveyor belt.
The input conveyor belt must face the large square and must not be ascending.
There are no restrictions for the output conveyor belts.

The outputs are color coded (red: first output and always on the left side relative to the input, yellow: second output and on the opposite side relative to the input, green: third output and on the right side relative to the input).
The item will be routed to the first output where the filter matched (Priority: OUT 1, OUT 2, OUT 3).
The filter matches if at least one pattern item of the output filter row matches the input item.
Pattern items can be placed by taking the item from the inventory and left-clicking a pattern slot. The filter can be reset by left-clicking without an item.
To allow any items select blacklist without any pattern items. If an output is not connected the filter should be set to whitelist without any pattern items.
A redstone signal of strength 15 will be emitted if no filter matches (If no output is connected or if it is full no redstone signal will be emitted).

book.energizedpower.page.io_configuratio: Most machines support Item/Fluid IO configuration.
Every machine has one ore more predefined slot groups per slot type (Item, Fluid).
Any slot within a slot group can be in one of the following modes:
Input (blue)
Output (orange)
Input/Output (green)
Any slot without highlighting is not part of this slot group.
To change the configuration of a side the slot type must be selected in the top left-hand corner in the IO Configuration view.
Afterwards one of the 6 side buttons can be used to select a slot group.
The slots from the currently configured slot group are highlighted when hovering above the side button.
Clicking the button will go to the next slot group. SHIFT + clicking the button will go to the previous slot group.
The color of the button is
Input (blue)
when all slots of the selected slot group are inputs
Output (orange)
when all slots of the selected slot group are outputs
Input/Output (green)
when the selected slot groups has input and output slots
Not configured (light gray)
when IO for the selected slot type is disabled
